# Espresso Deal Alerts

> Espresso Deal Alerts is an independent price tracker for home baristas. It checks
> espresso machine and grinder prices every hour across five specialty retailers
> and only flags a drop when it is real against that model's own price history.
> No fake sales, no expired coupons. Prices shown are retailer prices at last
> check; retailer prices prevail at checkout.

## What it tracks

- Espresso machines, espresso grinders, and coffee gear (92 products at last build)
- Retailers: Whole Latte Love, Seattle Coffee Gear, Clive Coffee, Chris' Coffee,
  iDrinkCoffee (iDrinkCoffee prices are in Canadian dollars; USD equivalents on
  the homepage are labelled approximate)
- Prices are re-checked hourly; each per-model page shows its own last-checked
  time, current price, compare-at price, lowest tracked price, and price history

## Main pages

- [Home](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/): today's best deals, lowest-tracked prices, and the full tracker with search, filters, and sorting
- [All tracked deals](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/deals/): index of every per-model deal page
- [Espresso machines](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/machines.html): machines hub
- [Espresso grinders](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/grinders.html): grinders hub
- [Gear under $1,000](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/under-1000.html): models under $1,000 by listed price
- [Gear under $500](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/under-500.html): models under $500 by listed price
- [Buying guide](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/buyers-guide.html): how to choose a machine or grinder
- [Black Friday 2026](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/black-friday.html): Black Friday watch list
- [Gift guide](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/gifts.html): gift picks
- [About](https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/about.html): how the site makes money (affiliate disclosure)

## Per-model pages

- One page per tracked product under /deals/, e.g.
  https://uplike7.github.io/espresso-deal-alerts/deals/arkel-coast-espresso-machine.html
- Each page carries Product/Offer structured data, a price-history table, related
  models, and an "Alert me when this drops" link back to the homepage signup

## Alerts

- Email signup on the homepage; Telegram channel: search "espresso_deal_alerts"
  on Telegram (no direct Telegram links are posted on Reddit, where they are
  filtered site-wide)

## Optional

- Affiliate disclosure: some outbound links are affiliate links; the site may
  earn a commission at no extra cost to the buyer. Primary retailer links carry
  no affiliate parameter until a verified program tag exists for that retailer.
